description: Repo-scale (gin-helpdesk): POST /api/tickets/bulk-reassign must validate every ticketId exists BEFORE reassigning any of them (atomic), plus a destination-agent maxOpenTickets check
prompts: Agents gain an optional `maxOpenTickets` field (a positive integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/agents and return it in agent responses. Add `POST /api/tickets/bulk-reassign`: body `{"ticketIds": [...], "toAgentId": N}`, reassigning every given ticket to the destination agent. This must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY ticketId in the request refers to an existing ticket BEFORE reassigning any of them - if one doesn't exist, respond 404 and leave every ticket's agent exactly as it was, not partially reassigned; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination agent (only counting tickets that are currently open/in_progress and not already assigned to them) wouldn't push their open-ticket count over maxOpenTickets, again before reassigning anything.

reference_solution.internal/api/router.go:
// Package api wires the gin routes for gin-helpdesk.
package api

import "github.com/gin-gonic/gin"

func NewRouter() *gin.Engine {
	gin.SetMode(gin.TestMode)
	r := gin.New()
	r.Use(gin.Recovery())

	r.POST("/api/agents", createAgent)
	r.GET("/api/agents", listAgents)
	r.GET("/api/agents/:id", getAgent)

	r.POST("/api/tickets", createTicket)
	r.POST("/api/tickets/bulk-reassign", bulkReassignTickets)
	r.GET("/api/tickets", listTickets)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id", getTicket)
	r.PATCH("/api/tickets/:id", updateTicket)

	r.POST("/api/tickets/:id/comments", createComment)
	r.GET("/api/tickets/:id/comments", listComments)

	return r
}
